components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action using the current theme accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--cyan);color:var(--night);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:.85rem;padding:.75rem 1rem;font:700 .88rem Space Grotesk,sans-serif;transition:translate 150ms ease,background 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease,box-shadow 150ms ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{translate:0 -.15rem}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--solar);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Soft secondary action on a panel surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{background:var(--panel-soft);color:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.85rem;padding:.75rem 1rem;font:700 .88rem Space Grotesk,sans-serif;transition:translate 150ms ease,background 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{translate:0 -.15rem;border-color:var(--cyan)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--solar);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.northStar: The cozy ShadowNine workshop at Miami dusk
narrative.overview: Tails is the preserved indigo workshop baseline. GTA6 is the default Afterglow theme: warm plum surfaces, sunset accents, teal controls, and bold condensed headings while body copy remains plain and readable.

rules.name: Shared Token Rule
rules.body: Use the same semantic variables across themes; only the theme mapping changes.

rules.name: Plain Body Rule
rules.body: Keep Space Grotesk for body text in both themes.

dos: Do preserve native selector and keyboard behavior.
donts: Don't add seasonal scheduling, HUDs, wanted stars, or grit.
